voiceSummary: Reliance Industries Limited disclosed that its executives will participate in the JM Financial India Conference in Mumbai on November 17, 2026. The meeting is organized by a third party and is expected to be conducted on a one-on-one basis with investors. The company confirmed that no unpublished price sensitive information is proposed to be shared or discussed during this meeting. This disclosure is made under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.
